❤️ Shopee Image Downloader - Download HD images and videos from Shopee product detail pages

📥 Download variants, main, and description images and videos from Shopee product detail pages and export product titles, SKUs, variants, and URLs to Excel with one click. 
Shopee Image Downloader allows you to easily download HD images and videos from Shopee Product Pages and save their details in an Excel file (*.xlsx).

⭐ **Getting Started:**

🚀 Click "Add to Chrome" to install the extension.
🛍️ Open your target Shopee product page.
📸 Click on the Shopee Image Downloader icon to open it.
📥 Download product images by variants, main, and description.
📊 Export images and video details to Excel.

⭐ **Features:**

🗂️ Download Variant Images (ZIP format)
📑 Export Variant Details (Excel format, XLSX)
🖼️ Download Main Images (ZIP format)
📋 Export Main Details (Excel format, XLSX)
📝 Download Description Images (ZIP format)
📒 Export Description Details (Excel format, XLSX)
🎥 One-Click Download Videos (MP4 format)
🖱️ One-Click Download All Images (ZIP format)
📊 One-Click Export All Details (Excel format, XLSX)

❓ **Is it free?**
Yes, Shopee Image Downloader is free to use.

❓ **Why Choose Shopee Image Downloader?**

⚡ Fast and easy way to download Shopee product images and videos.
📝 Export product information including titles, SKUs, variants, and URLs directly to Excel.
📈 Perfect for sellers, researchers, and anyone needing to save product details from Shopee.
